$comment: Every action of a present person an action line, in present tense, with them as its subject (ActionLines.action_lines; contract action_lines). The operator, 2026-11-24, chat 950d879c: "She rose from her seat without proper tense/phrasing and without an action block." A possessive opener is the person's action, kept as 's ... (stored Name's ...); a pronoun means the nearest person named whose own pronoun (people's pronoun) doesn't say otherwise (build60's live run, 2026-11-24, chat d219ba90).

cases.name: "She rose from her seat" after Delphine speaks is her action, in the present; the rain stays narration

lines.text: Because that is not how my husband does business.
She rose from her seat. Rain drums on the roof.

runs_out: Because that is not how my husband does business.
wrong: She rose from her seat.

cases.name: "Bram Holloway sets down her teacup" in narration is Bram's action by name (whose it really is, the formatter's speaker check says)

lines.text: Bram Holloway sets down her teacup with precise care. Her knuckles are white.

runs_out: sets down her teacup with precise care.
wrong: Bram Holloway sets down her teacup with precise care.

cases.name: an action line in the past tense, its own subject in front, is put right

lines.text: She nodded slowly.

wrong: Delphine Halloway She nodded slowly.

cases.name: the world alone is narration, untouched

lines.text: Rain drums on the roof. The lamps gutter.

runs_out: Rain drums on the roof. The lamps gutter.
solo: Rain drums on the roof. The lamps gutter.

cases.name: "The ferry bumps against the post" in Hesk's own turn is the world, narration, never his action (live run, 2026-11-24)

lines.text: Shifts on his crate. The ferry bumps against the post with a hollow thunk.

runs_out: The ferry bumps against the post with a hollow thunk.
wrong: Old Hesk The ferry bumps against the post with a hollow thunk.
solo: The ferry bumps against the post with a hollow thunk.

cases.name: a bare surname ('Hesk spits') is Old Hesk, never the title; the ferry stays narration (live run, build56)

lines.text: Hesk spits. He mutters a prayer. The ferry bumps against the post with a hollow thunk.

runs_out: The ferry bumps against the post with a hollow thunk.
wrong: Hesk spits.
He mutters a prayer.
The ferry bumps against the post with a hollow thunk.
solo: The ferry bumps against the post with a hollow thunk.

cases.name: Hesk's own speech is never split inside its quotes, and his plain words stay his speech, never "Narrator:" in his message (live run, build58, chat d33b4ad5)

lines.text: Old Hesk eyes Tam warily. "Says you're from outside," he mutters, his voice rough as gravel. "But folk who pay their debts don't send strangers to collect what they owe. That miller's got himself into something he can't get out of, mark my words."

runs_out: mutters, his voice rough as gravel.
But folk who pay their debts don't send strangers to collect what they owe. That miller's got himself into something he can't get out of, mark my words.
wrong: Old Hesk eyes Tam warily.

cases.name: "Old Hesk's weathered face tightens" in his own turn is his action, Old Hesk's ..., never narration and never his name twice (live run, build58, chat adae1314; build60, 2026-11-24)

lines.text: Old Hesk's weathered face tightens. He leans closer, lowering his voice.

wrong: Old Hesk Old Hesk's weathered face tightens.
Old Hesk He leans closer, lowering his voice.

cases.name: a sentence ends at its closing quote: Hesk's line, then his action

lines.text: "Mark my words." Hesk spits.

wrong: Hesk spits.
